## About
Corvette Specialists is a repair shop on S. Cataract Avenue in San Dimas. We started out exclusively repairing and restoring Corvettes, and we still know them inside and out, from classic vintage models to modern ones.
Over time we expanded to offer a full range of services for GM cars, SUVs, and light trucks. Our ASE-certified technicians handle everything from an oil change or A/C repair to a complete engine overhaul or transmission repair.
We hold a 4.5 rating on Google from 30 reviews. Give us a call to make an appointment and we can help figure out what your car needs.

## Services
- Corvette service and repair: Diagnosis, maintenance, and repair for every Chevrolet Corvette model, classic or modern.
- Restoring Corvettes: Restoring Corvettes is where this shop got its start.
- Camaro, Firebird and GM models: Service and repair for Camaro, Firebird, and other GM models and light trucks.
- Oil change and A/C repair: Routine maintenance to keep your car running well.
- Engine overhaul and transmission repair: Bigger jobs, including complete engine overhauls and transmission repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Corvettes?
A: No. Corvettes are our specialty, but we also work on Camaro, Firebird, and other GM models and light trucks.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call at the shop and we can talk through what your car needs.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
